new comment 4802466 (near Gellérthegy, 11th district) / Created 2 days ago by YieldMapper
Unofficial way via StreetComplete 61.1 Attached photo(s): https://streetcomplete.app/p/283958.jpg GPS Trace: https://www.openstreetmap.org/user/YieldMapper/traces/11999796 / Updated 1 day ago by infeeeee
I noticed this track when I was here a month ago, but I think it's there because the Citadel is closed for reconstruction and tourists try to take a shortcut here. It seemed very dangerous, as this is the steepest part of the hill. The reconstruction will be finished later this year, I guess the track will be overgrown soon, so I think this track is temporary and shouldn't be mapped. https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Good_practice#Don't_map_temporary_events_and_temporary_features Let's leave this note open, I will resurvey the situation after the Citadel reopened.
